correctness.rationale: For an extraspecial p-group, G/Z(G) is a 2r-dimensional symplectic vector space over F_p and commutation is exactly orthogonality. When r=1, every nonzero vector has orthogonal complement equal to its line, so the noncentral graph is exactly p+1 disjoint cliques of size p(p-1); adjoining the p central universal vertices preserves perfectness. For r>=2, the five displayed vectors in two hyperbolic planes have zero symplectic products exactly on the five cyclic pairs and nonzero products on every chord, including characteristic two, so representatives induce C5. A fresh independent pairing calculation for p=2,3,5,7,11 reproduced the cycle pattern; the package verifier separately checks the rank-one blow-up and the witness for four primes. The symbolic argument, not the finite checks, proves all primes and all ranks.
